clue.text: Sailor is married to Elizabeth, a superior lady

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is the usual crossword sailor
Bess is a pet form of the name Elizabeth

explanation.surface: A seaman's marriage to a woman named Elizabeth, who is rather above him socially.
explanation.walkthrough: 'superior' points to Mother Superior, the head of a convent.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of a convent of nuns is its female superior.

clue.text: Clothes appear new on student

indicators.note: making something new out of the word appear means rearranging its letters

parts.note: L, the learner plate, stands for a student

explanation.surface: New clothes show up on a student.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' is the shuffle signal; 'on' in a down clue places the student's letter below.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal word for clothing or garments.

clue.text: Fish seems to be right in the light

indicators.note: right is placed in the middle of the word for the light

parts.note: a beam is a ray of light

explanation.surface: A fish seems to be glinting in the light.
explanation.definitionFit: A freshwater fish of the carp family.

clue.text: Tolerate a most unusual church

indicators.note: an unusual version of 'a most' has its letters in a different order

explanation.surface: Putting up with a highly eccentric church.
explanation.definitionFit: To be able to put up with something, as in 'I can't bear it'.

clue.text: Venerate a midnight rider

definitions.meaning: to hold in deep respect or awe
Paul ... made a famous midnight ride in 1775 to warn of British troops

explanation.surface: Honouring a figure who rode at night.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to regard with awe; the other is the American patriot Paul, whose night ride is celebrated in a Longfellow poem.

clue.text: A miracle-man, he's involved in jailbreak

indicators.note: letters involved together are tangled up into a new order

parts.note: the jail part of the word supplies its own letters, and the break that follows reinforces the mixing

explanation.surface: A wonder-worker turns out to have been mixed up in a prison escape.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament prophet who raised the dead and called down fire from heaven.

clue.text: So in love, with demeanour transformed

indicators.note: the word demeanour is transformed by rearranging its letters

explanation.surface: Someone smitten, their whole manner changed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being captivated by or infatuated with someone.

clue.text: Put to death — and do it with a will

definitions.meaning: to kill as a legal punishment
to carry out the terms of a will, as an executor does; also, to perform vigorously

explanation.surface: An execution, carried out with gusto.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is capital punishment; the other is to carry out or perform, as an executor carries out a testament.

clue.text: Disturb canary hatching here, possibly

indicators.note: hatching means devising or bringing out something new, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A warning not to upset a canary that may be nesting here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hatching' is the shuffle signal, while the whole clue also describes the answer: a protected place where birds breed.
explanation.definitionFit: A reserve where birds are protected and can nest and rear chicks undisturbed.

clue.text: Seen in church when spring returns before Easter starts

indicators.note: a word that returns goes back the way it came, so it reads backwards

parts.note: a spa is a mineral spring

indicators.note: the start of Easter is its first letter

explanation.surface: Something noticed in church as the spring season comes back ahead of Easter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns SPA into APS. 'spring' looks like the season but is a water source.
explanation.definitionFit: The semicircular recess at the east end of a church is an architectural feature found there.

clue.text: Rose and made a speech without a single drink

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the speech word goes around the rest

parts.note: orated means gave a formal speech
I, the Roman numeral, is a single one
gin is a spirit drink

explanation.surface: Someone stood up and spoke without touching a drop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside here, not lacking. 'Rose' is a verb: arose or sprang from.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean arose or came into being from a source.

clue.text: It's an offence to go to a part of Putin's Russia

parts.note: a crime is an offence against the law

explanation.surface: A jab at Russia's annexation of a peninsula as an unlawful act.
explanation.walkthrough: Russia annexed this peninsula from Ukraine in 2014, which the surface calls an offence.
explanation.definitionFit: The Black Sea peninsula that Russia annexed and claims as its territory.

clue.text: Conversation piece?

parts.note: not an object that starts a chat but a written passage of talk, such as part of a play script

explanation.walkthrough: A 'conversation piece' is usually an object that prompts talk; here it is a piece of writing made of conversation.
explanation.definitionFit: Spoken exchange between characters in a play or novel is a written stretch of talk.

clue.text: Spot gloomy principal

parts.note: a black mood is a gloomy one
a head teacher is a school principal

explanation.surface: Catching sight of a depressed headteacher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spot' looks like a verb, to notice; it is a pimple.
explanation.definitionFit: A pimple with a dark plug of sebum is a kind of skin blemish.

clue.text: One wouldn't credit such transactions

parts.note: not disbelief but payment: these deals involve no credit, only ready money

explanation.walkthrough: 'credit' seems to mean believe; it means giving deferred payment.
explanation.definitionFit: Deals paid for immediately with ready money involve no credit terms.

clue.text: Right in line

definitions.meaning: properly aligned or straight, as a wheel running straight

explanation.surface: Correctly placed in a row.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is correct; the other is exactly aligned, as in 'out of true' for crooked.

clue.text: Too wrapped up in financial solvency

indicators.note: the letters are enclosed within the phrase financial solvency, across its two words

explanation.surface: Someone too absorbed in keeping their finances afloat.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean as well or in addition.

clue.text: Loan may be arranged, though it's irregular

definitions.note: the definition describes a thing that is irregular, matching the noun

indicators.note: a loan being arranged lets its letters, with may, be put in a new order

explanation.surface: A loan might be set up, though the procedure is unorthodox.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' turns LOAN MAY into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something deviating from what is standard or expected is an oddity.

clue.text: Lout knocked nurse cold

indicators.note: knocked about, so the letters of nurse and cold are battered into a new order

explanation.surface: A thug knocked a nurse out cold.
explanation.definitionFit: A rogue or villain is a near synonym of a boorish oaf.

clue.text: We hear you possibly enlist in domestic service, perhaps

definitions.note: a kitchen tool is something in use in the home

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word is taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: the letter U is pronounced like the word you

indicators.note: possibly suggests another arrangement of the letters of enlist

explanation.surface: Rumour says you might sign up to work as a servant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' turns ENLIST into TENSIL. 'domestic service' suggests servants; here it is a household implement serving in the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen implement serves in the household, a cryptic take on being in service.

clue.text: Given an income, but at the finish was in debt

parts.note: an end is a finish
owed means was in debt

explanation.surface: Someone provided with money still ended up in debt.
explanation.definitionFit: To be provided with a permanent fund or source of money, as a college is.

clue.text: Pay for a seat

definitions.meaning: to ... a bill is to pay it
a wooden bench with a high back and arms

explanation.surface: Paying for a place to sit.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to clear a debt; the other is a long high-backed wooden bench.

clue.text: Philosopher offers wine and gold, when entertaining us

indicators.note: to entertain guests is to have them within, so the outer pieces hold us

parts.note: rosé is a pink wine
AU is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A thinker plies his guests with wine and gold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entertaining' means holding guests within, so the pronoun sits inside the wine-and-gold string.
explanation.definitionFit: Jean-Jacques, the eighteenth-century Genevan thinker of The Social Contract.

clue.text: Don't make a message plain

parts.note: the opposite of plain text: turning words into secret writing

explanation.walkthrough: 'plain' hints at plaintext, the readable version of a message before ciphering.
explanation.definitionFit: Converting a message into code keeps it from being readable to outsiders.

clue.text: Is able to hold on, as a rule

parts.note: can means is able to

explanation.surface: Someone capable of clinging on, as a general principle.
explanation.definitionFit: A general law or principle, especially a church decree.

clue.text: Frozen waterfalls?

parts.note: not ice on a cascade but water falling from the sky already frozen

explanation.walkthrough: 'waterfalls' suggests cascades; read as water falls, it is precipitation.
explanation.definitionFit: Showers of ice pellets are water falling from the sky in frozen form.

clue.text: None of it is good, it's said

definitions.text: None of it is good, it's said

parts.words: None of it is good, it's said
parts.note: a nod to the proverb that no tidings at all are good tidings

explanation.walkthrough: The saying is 'no news is good news'; the clue reads it as if none of the stuff is good.
explanation.definitionFit: Reports of recent events, the subject of the proverb about no tidings.

clue.text: Acquiescent types originally serving in a Gulf country

indicators.note: the first letter of serving is placed in the middle of the country name

parts.note: Yemen lies on the Gulf of Aden in Arabia

indicators.note: originally points to the first letter, where the word begins

explanation.surface: Compliant people originally serving in an Arabian state.
explanation.definitionFit: Sycophants who agree with everything a superior says are compliant people.

clue.text: Took off and levelled out

definitions.meaning: shaved wood off with a carpenter's tool
made smooth and flat, or skimmed along a surface as a boat does

explanation.surface: An aircraft took off and then flew level.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is shaving away wood with a carpenter's tool; the other is making a surface flat and smooth.
